objects.name: Detection technique coverage: cisco-isovalent-cron-job-creation
objects.description: The following analytic detects the creation of a cron job within the Cisco Isovalent environment. It identifies this activity by monitoring process execution logs for cron job creation events. This behavior is significant for a SOC as it could allow an attacker to execute malicious tasks repeatedly and automatically, posing a threat to the Kubernetes infrastructure. If confirmed malicious, this activity could lead to persistent attacks, service disruptions, or unauthorized access to sensitive in
